## event order

- PASS — state.snapshot arrives first
- PASS — experience.created before connection.updated (teach arc)
- PASS — dream.started < dream.hypothesis < dream.evaluated

## closing line

A passing gate proves the Gym faithfully exposes and interacts with AION. It does NOT prove the Gym makes AION more intelligent. AION's actual state and behaviour remain the truth; the Gym is the window into it, not an imitation of it.
